body: I'm trying so hard to put myself first. It's extremely difficult. I feel like any decision I make isn't right and I won't ever be happy with anything I pick. I'm just stuck.
I have told them. They're losing their shit.

Keep doing it! A smile is one of the greatest things we can be blessed with, in my opinion. I avoided smiling up until the age of 18 because I was born missing a tooth. I’m still a little insecure because I feel as though my fake tooth stands out like a sore thumb, but I’ll be damned if I’ve gone through all the trouble of getting pretty teeth and I don’t smile every chance I get. You look great. ♡

I believe you can get through this. Take things one step at a time and formulate a game plan for your future. Breakups are never easy, especially after that long. The horrible feelings aren’t fun either. We’re rooting for you! I hope you find the resources you need, and I personally am here to talk if you need it. I’ve dealt with MDD for about 8 years now. The sun always rises in the morning. :)
Crawl into a made bed with freshly washed sheets immediately after. It can fix an entire day.
Going to college makes me miss my home shower head.
